sample_unit: participants (third-year students, residents, specialists) summarising five NEJM cases

links.outcome: Diagnostic ranking quality of ChatGPT-4 responses by user expertise level
links.effect: Residents significantly outperformed students (OR 2.33, p = .007); overall diagnostic performance was low.
links.quote: Diagnostic ranking, assessed by independent experts, revealed that residents significantly outperformed students (OR 2.33, p = .007); though overall performance was low.

unlisted_practices: Using concise case summaries when prompting an LLM for diagnosis
Tailoring AI user-interaction and prompting training to user expertise level

screen.reason: Evaluates how differing levels of user medical training/prompting expertise (students vs residents vs specialists) affect the diagnostic accuracy of LLM outputs.
